openings: Could you stay a little longer?
acts: 这样摸就好，我有点害羞。
Like that is nice. I get a little shy.
returns: You were far away this time.
你回来了。我还愿意在这里等一小会儿。
You’re back. I still want to spend a little time here with you.
conditions: I was feeling a little sad.
I thought you might have forgotten me.
Head pats don’t fill a tummy. I’m really hungry.
Again? My hair will be all over the place.

acts: Let me lean in for a sec!
挨着我坐，我保证不乱跑。
Sit by me. I promise I won’t run off.
Yes! Just a tiny taste first.
那我把不开心分给你一点。
Then you can have a little of my bad mood.
returns: I saved up so much to tell you!
你怎么这么久才回来！先陪我一下。
That took forever! Come sit with me for a bit.
conditions: I’m in such a good mood today.
I really was upset a minute ago.
You didn’t even see me before!
My stomach’s louder than I am!
Another pat? My hair’s going to look like a nest.

acts: Sit, then. I’m only taking a short break.
returns: So you do know the way back.
还知道回来。说好下次早点。
You made it. A little sooner next time, okay?
我都把袖子挽起来好几回了。
I rolled up my sleeves to look for you more than once.
So you do know the way back! …I’m glad.
conditions: Good timing. Today’s been going my way.
我不是委屈。就是刚才有点闷。
I wasn’t sulking. I was just a bit low.
I figured you got busy and forgot.
又来？这头发可是刚理过的。
Again? I’d just fixed my hair.

acts: I tilted my head. I didn’t pull away.
Let’s sit here just like this.
returns: …It’s been a while. Glad you remembered the way.
conditions: It’s quiet today. I like that.
A pat won’t fill my stomach.

gentle: 我想讲个很小的故事。
要是浪能装进口袋呢？
我会装最轻的那一个。
等你觉得屋子太静，就把它放出来。
Here’s a very small story.
What if a wave could fit in a pocket?
I’d take the quietest one.
When the house felt too still, you could let it out.
我想讲个很小的故事。
我想象有条路能走到月亮后面。
那边也许没有路灯。
我们就把脚步放轻，一块慢慢走。
Here’s a very small story.
I picture a path behind the moon.
There might not be any lights.
We could walk it together, nice and slow.
我想讲个很小的故事。
一颗小石头以为自己是座岛。
水在它周围转啊转。
后来它才发现，小也可以是一个家。
Here’s a very small story.
A pebble thought it was an island.
Water went around and around it.
Then it found out a home can be very small.
我想讲个很小的故事。
如果窗沿上长出一片海呢？
雨点落进去，溅起一个小码头。
我们就坐在旁边听，今天哪里都不用去。
Here’s a very small story.
What if a sea grew on the windowsill?
A raindrop might splash up a little dock.
We could sit beside it and stay right where we are.
我想讲个很小的故事。
梦里每棵树都有一盏灯。
最小的一盏照到两双鞋子。
光不大，够我们走到火边。
Here’s a very small story.
In a dream, each tree had a lantern.
The smallest one lit two pairs of shoes.
It wasn’t much, but it could get us to the fire.
我想讲个很小的故事。
我想给风编一张椅子。
它平时总在跑。
如果它坐下来，我们就能一起听火。
Here’s a very small story.
I’d like to weave a chair for the wind.
It spends all its time running.
If it sat down, we could both listen to the fire.
